# Gramil assembly

Source: `/Users/paul/repos/gramil/dist/step/gramil_assembly.step`, the maintainer’s
Gramil marking gauge, copied 2026-10-30. Copyright Paul Fremantle. OCL v1;
see the adjacent LICENSE-gramil. Gzip has no timestamp or original filename.

Twelve leaf products, with four blade retainers and two blades. Seven GRM
products and the push rod are made; the grub screw, flat washer and two
pan-head screw lengths are bought. The assembly retains product names,
product identity, placements and geometry; it is not split or relabelled.
